fields.statement: At af6b1ab, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-status|describe-golden)$' -count=1 -v passes. daemon-status.txtar runs rhiza daemon status before any daemon (text 'Daemon not running', --json running:false); after rhiza daemon --once --max-runs=3 --autonomous with a fake rex on PATH it shows the state the daemon left: text 'Daemon not running' plus last daemon process/stopped, Max runs: 3, Autonomous: true, Last started: a run of <change>, and --json with running:false, max_runs 3, autonomous true, last_started {change, at}; then with the state file removed and daemon.lock naming pid 999999 it says not running and no Last started. describe-golden.txtar carries the new daemon.status operation and passes. Diff read: daemon.State written under the git common dir (.git/rhiza/daemon.state.json) at each poll and on stop, with process, start, last poll, max runs, autonomous, live runs and last started/resumed; status takes running from daemon.Running on the lock. make fmt-check vet test pass; make self-check fails only on .rhiza/rendered actor/index drift that HEAD~1 shows too, outside this leaf.
